freeze_boundary: Defined before any CUT-01-R, TRIM-01-R or CUT-02 episode. Each task inherits its base task's v1 success thresholds unchanged; only geometry, fixtures, tool and reference path differ. No result-based threshold changes under this protocol.
tool_profiles: src/robotic_cutting_sim/tool_profile.py (ToolProfile.to_dict is recorded in every task receipt)

CUT-01-R.reason: CUT-01 workpiece, fixtures, path and thresholds with the ruler knife held vertically (edge across the bar).

TRIM-01-R.reason: TRIM-01 with the ruler knife at a 25 deg rake about the edge line: the spine-mounted handle and finger pads (about 11-19 mm below the blade plane, 40-80 mm behind the edge) clear the trimmed plane by about 7-8 mm, and the lower bevel rises behind the edge, so the edge is the lowest tool point.

CUT-02.reason: Wider and taller bar (60 x 25 mm section) severed by the 120 mm ruler edge; CUT-01 thresholds.
